[LSIG.6.2] Two assumptions cut across all three:

- **Monotone timestamps.** DS series do not reorder. An assertion whose
  timestamp precedes the backing's most recent recorded timestamp is silently
  discarded; the adapter owns ordering and buffering. An adapter connecting to
  a boolean sensor already in the `true` state must assert `true` at connect
  time, before any subsequent change, or `SeriesBackendIntervalPulse` returns `active_fraction = 0`
  until the first observed rising edge.
- **Periodic re-evaluation.** See §[LSIG.7].
